name: GSC Forum Cut
summary: **GSC Forum Cut** is a [[kind:cut|phenotype]] of [[gsc|GSC]] that circulated among growers through online cultivation forums in the early 2010s. It is one of several distinct clones selected from GSC's original seed population, alongside the [[thin-mint-gsc|Thin Mint]] and [[platinum-gsc|Platinum]] cuts. No formal breeder is credited with isolating it.
